Force constraint¶

Fixed force harmonic¶

class FixedForceHarmonic(all_info, group)¶

The constructor of a fixed harmonic force object for a group of particles. The fixed harmonic force can be applied to the particles at X, Y, Z, XY, YZ, XZ, and XYZ by the free combination of setFixedPosition() functions.

Parameters:

  • all_info (AllInfo) – The system information.

  • group (ParticleSet) – The group of constraint particles.

setParams(string type, float K, float r_0)¶

sets the harmonic interaction parameters for the type particles where K is the strength and r_0 is the equilibrium length.

setFixedPositionX(float x)¶

set the fixed position at X direction.

setFixedPositionY(float y)¶

set the fixed position at Y direction.

setFixedPositionZ(float z)¶

set the fixed position at Z direction.

Example:

ffh = gala.FixedForceHarmonic(all_info, group)
ffh.setParams("A", 100.0, 1.0) #particle type, harmonic constant, equilibrium length
ffh.setFixedPositionZ(0.0) #fixed position at Z direction
app.add(ffh)
